content:
It's six o'clock at a travel company in Da Nang. Quyen is picking up her bag when she sees her co-worker Thang near the door.

"Thang, wait! You haven't turned off your computer."
"Oh, it's fine. It goes to sleep after an hour."
"But it still uses electricity. If everyone leaves their computers on, the company will waste a lot of power."
"Is it really that much?"
"Yes. I've been checking the electricity bill for three months. It has been going up every month."
"Maybe it's the air conditioner."
"That too. People have been leaving it on all night. Unless we turn it off, the bill will be huge again this month."
"OK, OK. I'll turn off my computer."
"And the lights in the meeting room, please. Nobody turns them off."
Thang asks, "Why do you care so much? It's not your money."
"It's not only about money. Most of our electricity comes from coal. Coal makes a lot of smoke, and it adds to global warming."
"Really? I didn't know that."
"If we use less electricity, we'll help the planet a little."
"Fine. I'll put a note on the printer. It will say, 'Turn me off!'"
Quyen laughs. "Good idea. If the boss sees it, he'll love it."

grammarNote.title: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (if, unless)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Câu điều kiện loại 1 dùng để nhắc nhở và cảnh báo về kết quả có thể xảy ra: If everyone leaves their computers on, the company will waste a lot of power. Unless = nếu … không: Unless we turn it off, the bill will be huge. Trong mệnh đề If / Unless dùng hiện tại đơn, kể cả khi nói về tương lai. Bài cũng có hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn: I've been checking the electricity bill for three months.
examples: If everyone leaves their computers on, the company will waste a lot of power."
Unless we turn it off, the bill will be huge again this month."
"If we use less electricity, we'll help the planet a little."

practice.grammarTipVi: Cảnh báo, nhắc nhở: If we buy new lights, the bill will go down a little. / Unless someone turns it off at six, it runs all night. Việc kéo dài đến giờ: Quyen has been asking everyone to save electricity.

grammarStep.questionVi: Quyên muốn nói: nếu mọi người không tắt điều hoà thì hoá đơn sẽ rất cao. Câu nào đúng?
options: Unless we turn it off, the bill will be huge.
Unless we don't turn it off, the bill will be huge.
Unless we will turn it off, the bill is huge.
grammarStep.explanationVi: Unless đã mang nghĩa phủ định (nếu … không), đi với hiện tại đơn; mệnh đề chính dùng will.
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng khi nhắc nhở hoặc cảnh báo: nói rõ điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu người khác làm, hoặc không làm, một việc.

table.subject: If + hiện tại đơn
table.form: If we use less electricity, we'll help the planet.
table.negative: If we don't turn it off, the bill will be huge.

table.subject: Unless + hiện tại đơn
table.form: Unless we turn it off, the bill will be huge.

table.subject: will / 'll
table.negative: won't: The bill won't go down.

mistakes.wrong: If everyone will leave their computers on, we will waste power.
mistakes.right: If everyone leaves their computers on, we will waste power.

mistakes.wrong: Unless you don't turn off the lights, the bill will go up.
mistakes.right: Unless you turn off the lights, the bill will go up.

grammarStep.noteVi: Chủ ngữ số ít trong mệnh đề If (everyone, the boss, someone) thì động từ thêm -s: If everyone leaves …, If the boss sees …

outlineVi: Chào mọi người và nêu vấn đề (hoá đơn điện đang tăng …).
Nhờ mọi người tắt những gì trước khi về.
Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu mọi người làm / không làm (If … / Unless …).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: Hi everyone, our electricity bill has been going up for three months. Please turn off your computer and the lights before you leave. If we all do this, we will save a lot of money. Unless we turn off the air conditioner at night, the bill will be huge again. Thank you!
